notes.note: Reviewed current-main integration of the portable delivery sequence and conversation-wide key decision/start guard. Verified169 focused tests, 28 restored route tests after a guard-bypass mutation caused the intended queued-versus-sending failure (with a separate cleanup timeout), rebuilt plain-Node/declaration smoke, and source-only independent approval atb913. Runtime stays byte-identical; this review does not claim hosted or queue qualification.
